description: PLA category-level (category_l1 / category_l2 / category_l3) performance for a marketplace over ONE period: PLA spend, clicks, program (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) GMV, orders and product-views, plus the distinct merchant count, grouped by category hierarchy. Left unfiltered it returns the marketplace category aggregate; add a merchant_id filter (the analyzed seller_id, or list of seller_ids) to get that merchant's per-category subtotal for the same categories. Compare the merchant subtotal call vs the unfiltered aggregate to derive category vs merchant CPC / ROI / GMV-share. Called once per period; run current + baseline for a comparison.

category_l1.description: Top-level (L1) product category the spend/clicks/GMV were attributed to.

merchant_id.description: Merchant (seller) id (working id for internal analysis). Per-call filter: pass the analyzed merchant's seller_id (or a list of seller_ids) to scope the result to that merchant's per-category subtotal; omit it to get the full marketplace category aggregate. Resolve os_client_id -> seller_id upstream and pass the resolved seller_id(s) here.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.pla_cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: PLA ad spend for this category (source table stored currency; not currency-converted).

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.pla_clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: PLA ad clicks for this category.

program_gmv.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_gmv.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) GMV / sales for this category.

program_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_orders.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) conversions / orders for this category.

program_viewproducts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_viewproduct ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_viewproducts.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) product views for this category (used for merchant CVR = orders / views).

merchant_count.selector: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.merchant_id END)
merchant_count.description: Distinct merchants that had activity in this category over the period (full category when unfiltered; the analyzed merchant(s) when a merchant_id filter is applied).

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_category_level_performance_facts_v2` AS f WHERE f.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
